title: Ras el Hanout Spice Blend
summary: A warm blend of paprika, coriander, cumin, cinnamon, cardamom, nutmeg, cloves and cayenne with a touch of sugar and salt.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: Put all the ground spices, the sugar and the salt into the small bowl.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir thoroughly, pressing out any lumps of sugar, until the colour is even.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: Spoon into a small airtight jar and seal.

steps.title: Use
steps.text: Rub about 1 tsp per 150 g over chicken, lamb or vegetables before roasting, or stir into tagines and stews.

tips: Toast and grind whole spices for a stronger aroma.
Add a pinch of ground ginger or dried rose petals if you like.
Leave out the cayenne for a mild blend.
Label the jar with the date.
storage: Keep in a sealed jar in a cool, dark cupboard for up to 3 months. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
